layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_protocol: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for portfolio & services showcase (mixing col-span-full, col-span-8, col-span-4 with asymmetric offsets and generous 1px border lines)

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis (momentum scroll setup in root App component)
framer_motion_hooks: Staggered line-by-line reveal for Hero Headline
Scroll-triggered fade-up for section titles and grid cards
3D tilt/perspective rotation on hover for Hero Showcase Frame
Tab switching layout animations with layoutId
micro_interactions: Hover effect on buttons: subtle scale, icon translate-x, contrast inversion
Hover effect on portfolio cards: image scale 1.05 with border color shift
Active tab indicator with smooth sliding background

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: EVERY interactive element (buttons, tabs, form inputs, accordion triggers, card links) MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-submit-button')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_compliance: WCAG AA 4.5:1 text ratio strictly maintained
testing_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Framer motion components check for prefers-reduced-motion
